$Comment: How the "stations" achievement category is presented: the work-station achievements this pack ships, the Sawmill's under the sawmill subcategory. Order is a sort key among categories, so leaving gaps lets a new category slot in without renumbering (the jar's own run from 0 to 60 in steps of ten, and 25 seats this one between Crafting and Leveling); Icon is the fallback shown for an achievement in this category that authored none of its own; Subcategories names the reading order inside it, and one left out still shows, it just sorts after the named ones. Add a subcategory name here when a later station ships its own achievements. The header reads its title from achievement.category.stations in a language file. Override this file by id to retune any of the three.
